enchantments.tooltip: Speed X: Passive: +30% enhancement bonus to movement speed, +10% enhancement bonus to melee and ranged attack speed.
Freedom of Movement: This item grants its wearer the ability to move and attack normally while under the influence of magic that impedes movement, such as paralysis, solid fog, slow and web.
Fire Resistance +50: Passive: +50 Enhancement bonus to your Fire Resistance.
Fire Absorption +30%: Passive: 30% Enhancement Bonus to Fire Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)
Mythic Boot Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
